description: Constructs that the ANTLR sysml-validator rejects although they are valid SysML v2. Each gap cites an OFFICIAL OMG model that fails the same way (evidence). Files listed in 'exemptFromAntlrSyntax' skip only the ANTLR syntax suite; they still go through name/rule checks and must load in CATIA Magic. run_tests.py asserts the evidence files still fail, so an exemption is flagged for removal when the validator is fixed.

gaps.construct: then include use case ... (succession to an included use case)
gaps.evidence: sysml/src/training/35. Use Cases/Use Case Usage Example.sysml

gaps.construct: in parameter declared in a state def / state usage body

cameoConfirmation: 2026-09-16: examples/06-OnlineStoreBehavior.sysml, which uses all four constructs, loads in CATIA Magic 2026x Refresh1 with 0 errors and 0 validation-engine failures, confirming these are ANTLR-validator gaps.
